capabilities: Clip Xiaohongshu image-text notes into Markdown with tags and full-resolution images
Download Bilibili and YouTube videos locally via yt-dlp
Transcribe narration-only subtitles with whisper.cpp, skipping background music
Segment subtitles into natural sentences with single-point timestamps
Save notes and media to configurable vault folders with a progress panel
extras: Requires macOS (Apple Silicon recommended) and several external tools installed via brew; a settings self-check verifies the environment. The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Docs mention a 'ZeroCloud family' of plugins built with Claude-assisted development.
problem: Saving Xiaohongshu posts and video narration into Markdown normally requires cloud APIs or manual copying, which this does offline with no cost.

relations.evidence: Everything runs locally: yt-dlp for downloads, whisper.cpp (large-v3-turbo) for transcription
yt-dlp for downloads, whisper.cpp (large-v3-turbo) for transcription, silero-vad for voice detection

summary: Web clipper that saves Xiaohongshu posts, Bilibili and YouTube videos, and web articles as local Markdown notes, with local transcription.
